title: Console approvals: system notes in approval history follow the browser's language, not the chosen UI language — the approvals fetch helper sends no Accept-Language
body:
## What happens

A user whose Console language is **English** opens a record that went through an approval. In the approval history, the system note the server writes when `excludeSubmitter` removes the submitter appears in the **browser's** language (here zh-CN), not the chosen one:

> "本步骤设置了 excludeSubmitter，提交人已从审批人中移除；没有其他人可以处理，只有特权管理员的强制处理才能决定此请求。"

Every other string on the page is English, including step labels and buttons.

## Why

`plugin-approvals` renders this note at **read** time, in the request's locale (`submitterExclusionNoteText(note, render)` → `approvalSubmitterExcluded*` keys; all locales ship). The Console's approvals fetch helper sends no language, so the server falls back to the browser's `Accept-Language`.

- `record-approvals-renderer-*.js`: `K(path)` builds headers as `{"Content-Type", ...authHeaders()}`. `authHeaders` (`authToken-*.js`) returns only `Authorization`. That helper serves `/approvals/requests/:id`, `/approvals/requests/:id/actions` and `/remind`.
- `approvalRequestsDataSource-*.js` follows the same pattern for the inbox list, actions, approve and reject.
- Compare `data-adapter`, which passes `{"Accept-Language": client.getLocale()}` for `/meta/view` and export.

The same request answered by the server:

| Request | `comment` on the `action: "comment"` row |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/actions`, browser default (zh-CN) | 本步骤设置了 excludeSubmitter… |
| same, with `Accept-Language: en` | The request's submitter was removed from its approvers because this step sets excludeSubmitter; no one else could take it, so only a privileged override can decide it. |

`process_label` / `step_label` on `/approvals/requests/:id` follow the same pattern (`报销单审批` / `上级审核` vs `Expense Report Approval` / `Manager Review`). Any other approvals surface that shows server-rendered text is affected the same way.

## Repro (18.6.0, `pnpm dev` of an app with an approval step that sets `excludeSubmitter`, e.g. HotCRM's expense report approval)

1. Use a browser whose language is zh-CN. Choose **English** in avatar → Preferences → Language (`objectui-locale = en`, `<html lang="en">`).
2. As the only possible approver, submit a record so `excludeSubmitter` leaves no one (route `no_one`).
3. Open the record and look at the approval history.

**Expected:** the note is in English, the Console's language, as every other approvals string the reader sees.
**Actual:** the note is in Chinese, the browser's language.

## Suggested direction

Send the Console's current locale on every approvals request: `Accept-Language: <ui locale>`, as `data-adapter` already does. Better still, make the shared auth-header helper add it, so other plugin pages' fetches don't repeat this.

Related but different: #27625 (Accept-Language outranks the UI language for date cells), #36463 (English words in approvals refusals).

Versions: `@objectstack/console` 18.6.0, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` 18.6.0.
